requires: Actual part geometry, electrical function, mechanical retention, joining, neighboring heat, failed-part extraction, reconnecting and finite stock renewal belong to the useful assembly/rework operation. assumptions: Site binding yield is not functioning-device yield. Configurable-circuit company pages are maker claims, not a qualified delivered process or renewal life. The Lorenz model is not universal to real contacts; actual substrate, fluid, radiation and mechanical heat paths remain. Complete release/rejoin and useful device function are unconstructed. Numerical energy residuals and timestep checks validate only the declared calculation, not materials. No novel device, universal obstruction or advantage is claimed.
costs: Whole unchanged 14,647-byte ROOT note 6fee8fe4 and supplied 7,576-byte Python 94c52adc/5,009-byte JSON 4bb074c0 are published as evidence, not executed by Capital. obstruction: Construct and qualify actual heterogeneous assembly and selective replacement with owned parts, real retention, accessible connections, measured electrical function and full neighboring temperature trajectories. Compare ordinary rework, sockets, carriers, flex circuits and configurable wiring fairly. Proposed experiments remain unexecuted and require later authority for hardware or spending.
